info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Generated from the live router — every operation below is a route the unified cloud binary actually serves. Tagged by product: the first path segment after /v1/.

get.summary: discover lists every tool and agent resolvable in the caller's (org, project),
get.description:
discover lists every tool and agent resolvable in the caller's (org, project),
overlaid with any public listing's title, category and price, and flags the
ones the caller already has installed.

post.summary: install activates a tool for the caller's (org, project) — the marketplace
post.description:
install activates a tool for the caller's (org, project) — the marketplace
"install" IS the tool-plane activation write, so the two never drift.

get.summary: listListings returns the listings the caller's org has published, monetized or not.
get.description: listListings returns the listings the caller's org has published, monetized or not.

post.summary:
publish records a listing for a tool the publisher can actually offer (it must
resolve in the publisher's scope).
post.description:
publish records a listing for a tool the publisher can actually offer (it must
resolve in the publisher's scope). A monetized listing (priceCents>0) MUST name a
recipient wallet — the x402 payout target. Ownership policy (who may monetize a
platform-owned tool) is a follow-on; existence is enforced here.

delete.summary: unpublish removes one of the caller org's listings and answers 204.
delete.description:
unpublish removes one of the caller org's listings and answers 204. A listing
belonging to another org reads as not found.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID is the listing id from the path, as returned by publish.

post.summary: uninstall deactivates a tool for the caller's (org, project).
post.description: uninstall deactivates a tool for the caller's (org, project).

items.description: Items is the catalog, one entry per resolvable tool or agent.

tool.description: Tool is the registry tool name.

installed.description: Installed is the resulting activation state for the caller's (org, project).

tool.description: Tool is the tool the write applied to.

listings.description: Listings is the caller org's listings; empty, never null, when it has none.

amountCents.description: AmountCents is the per-call price in minor units.

currency.description: Currency is the ISO 4217 code; empty means USD.

recipient.description: Recipient is the seller payout wallet the x402 settlement targets.

activated.description: Activated reports whether the tool is switched on for the caller's scope.

category.description: Category is the listing's shop category, present only for a listed tool.

description.description: Description is the tool's own one-line description.

dispatchable.description: Dispatchable reports whether the tool can be called, not merely listed.

inputSchema.description: Schema is the tool's JSON-Schema input contract, absent when it declares none.

installed.description: Installed reports whether the tool is activated for the caller's scope.

name.description: Name is the tool's registry name, unique in the caller's scope.

price.description: Price is the per-call price, present only for a monetized listing.

source.description: Source is the plane the tool comes from (builtin, mcp, connector, ...).

title.description: Title is the listing's shop title, present only for a listed tool.

category.description: Category groups the listing in discovery.

currency.description: Currency is the price's currency code.

description.description: Description is the shop copy, at most 4096 characters.

priceCents.description: PriceCents is the per-call price in minor units; 0 publishes it free.

public.description: Public exposes the listing in every org's discovery, not just the publisher's.

recipient.description: Recipient is the seller payout wallet, required when priceCents is above 0.

title.description: Title is the shop title, required, at most 200 characters.

tool.description: Tool is the registry tool name to list; it must resolve in the publisher's scope.
